body:
Thanks for the report!

A couple potential solutions come to mind:

1. Maybe if we fail to copy the DLL, we should just open the original? Although, that would make it difficult to update the DLL on every other restart, which is less bad, but still a weird issue to have if/when users notice it
2. We could also use a different name if there's a pre-existing copy? I think we may have had this in one of the PRs adjusting this code at one point, but I personally pushed back against it, because we didn't have a great way to clean up additional copies and I was worried about them accruing

> 2. We could also use a different name if there's a pre-existing copy? I think we may have had this in one of the PRs adjusting this code at one point, but I personally pushed back against it, because we didn't have a great way to clean up additional copies and I was worried about them accruing

I prefer this solution personally. Can we write the new file to a temporary path (`FileAccess::create_temp()`) until we are 100% certain that we'll be able to replace the current one?

not sure if this is related but i have been facing similar problem using EOSG plugin ... full issue description

Describe the bug
installing the plugin causes the restart function stops working, (The engine closes but does not start again)

To Reproduce

    1 - create a new project
    2 - install the EOSG
    3 - reload the project from Project/Reload current project

Expected behavior
the project to open again after it is closed with a reload, either through Project menu or Render pipeline swap


Operating System:
Linux mint 22.2
Windows 11

Plugin version:
"2.2.4"
"2.2.6"
encountered in older versions as well

Godot version:
4.5.1
4.4.1

Additional context
The problem persists even if the plugin is disabled, 

I would also note that while testing this issue with EOSG, I had godot-git-plugin installed on 4.4.1 and I did not catch this problem even though I was testing for this issue ... I tested it right now on linux mint 22.3 a couple times and had no issue ... however the maintainer of EOSG test reloading with EOSG on macos and he reported no issue
